build_verdict_reason: Five verified, publicly accessible PRIMARY_LEAD_SOURCE feeds: Magistrate Court evictions (daily, HIGH), State Court civil judgments (HIGH), Probate estates via georgiaprobaterecords.com (MEDIUM — live date search still to be sampled), Tax Commissioner monthly tax sale listings (HIGH) and excess-funds listing (HIGH). Blocked: GSCCCA clerk indexes (lis pendens, deeds, FiFa/tax/mechanics liens) need a paid subscription; non-judicial foreclosure / sheriff sale notices on GeorgiaPublicNotice.com are reCAPTCHA-gated with no-scraping terms; bankruptcy needs PACER. Foreclosure — the highest-value Georgia signal — is therefore not covered until the operator supplies GSCCCA access or a manual notice feed.
